text:
Toni: Vertex pilot wrap-up  theyre open to a short case study + a live demo webinar. Need signed release and a final quote before we draft the blog.

Ravi: Can we do a 20-min customer interview next Wed? Also want a hero metric. They reported ~2.8x latency reduction in 90-day tests.

Nora (Vertex): Wed works. We can confirm the 2.8x on the call and share the test logs under NDA. We'll need an embargo until the webinar date.

Camila (Legal): Upload the exact quote here and we'll issue the standard release. Embargo clause ok, need duration (days). Also add data-source sentence to the release.

Toni: Draft hero: "Vertex saw a 2.8x reduction in latency and cut inference spend by nearly half during our pilot." Thoughts?

Camila (Legal): "Nearly half" is fine, but add the measurement window (90 days) in the release. Replace ambiguous language if they don't provide the spend baseline.

Nora (Vertex): 90-day window is correct. We'll share the spend baseline in the spreadsheet. Embargo for 10 days post-webinar preferred.

Jules (Events): If we do a webinar, suggest Wed 2pm PT. Marketing can run a co-hosted demo and reserve a Q&A. Need final quote and release 72h before promo.

Ravi: OK locking Wed 2pm PT for the customer interview + planning. Action items: Vertex to upload logs + spend sheet, Legal to prepare release with 10d embargo, Marketing to draft promo copy after release signed.

Nora (Vertex): Uploading artifacts now. Signing release after redline review.

Camila (Legal): I created a quick redline with the embargo and data-source phrasing: "Benchmarking based on a 90-day production pilot; data provided by Vertex under NDA." Link: https://legal.redwood/cases/3619004321-redline

Toni: Thanks. Once signed, we'll do a copy approval thread for the blog + social + webinar landing. Target publish: webinar + post at T+0, then short blog three days after.

Jules (Events): I'll set up the webinar page and speaker slots after release is signed. Tagging events-team for promo timeline.

Ravi: I'll draft the hero + three bullets and post for approvals tomorrow AM.

Nora (Vertex): Signing now. Looking forward to the call.

Camila (Legal): Marking redline resolved upon upload. :white_check_mark:
